full_details: In the morning you told them to bow to the chair, whoever was in it. You did not give the chair a name. Kemp was not in the nine. The three leaves were not spoken in the yard. At two you were Egeon, and the old margin was still on the roll. You went home for a clean band and did not bring a name into the close. At Old Swan the flood was at the last of it, and the fare was the standing two pence. In the parlour the floor was six paces by four. My lord was not there. Lady Hoby moved the candles and found the stool. Sir Edward presented a king, not a preface. You died as Gaunt close enough to smell the orris. The line went a foot past Sir Robert's ear, and he did not move. Later the crown was given with Burbage's own hands, and the glass was dashed. Four shillings. No one at the table stirred. The purse was five pounds, in Heminges's hand before the last speech, and the four shillings was not taken off it. Twelve and six the share. Lady Hoby thanked Nicholas and Arthur by name. Sir Robert said one sentence. You did not decide what it meant. Nobody asked. The tide was gone. On the Strand, at a shut gate, Burbage came out of the king and was only cold.
one_sentence: You were Egeon at two and Gaunt after supper, the king was given whole, and on the Strand he asked if the little man had liked it.
title: Gave the king whole, and walked from the Strand
